stem: Imran must measure $\angle ABC$ with a protractor.

parts.text: Which claim correctly states how he must place the protractor?

options.text: Place the protractor centre on vertex $B$, align arm $BA$ with the $0^{\circ}$ line, and read the scale reached by arm $BC$.
Place the protractor centre on the midpoint of $AB$ and read any convenient mark on the scale.
Align the protractor centre with point $C$ and ignore vertex $B$.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The centre must sit on the vertex and one arm on the zero line so the other arm shows the angle measure on the scale.

teacher.key_rationale: Measuring ∠ABC needs the centre at B with BA on 0° and BC read on the scale. Midpoint of AB or centre at C omit the vertex placement.
